about_the_game:
A new Action Roguelike game based on the Skibidi Toilet universe!

Explore the bunker dungeons along the way finding better and better weapons, defeating dangerous opponents along the way to defeat the main boss!

This is a game where you can open new agents, upgrade them and go on a journey to a huge bunker. In a variety of locations, you can find unique weapons, upgrade your agent with a variety of items to defeat dangerous opponents that lurk there.

Toilet Boom is A new Action Roguelike game based on the Skibidi Toilet universe:

• more than 6 types of locations with procedural generation

• more than 100 unique weapons of varying rarity

• unique agents with cool abilities

• more than 100 items to upgrade your agents

• various dangerous opponents and unique bosses
